_comment: Drip sequences: timed follow-up messages from each contact's enrollment. afterDays/afterHours are measured from when the contact was enrolled (day 0 = immediately). Enroll contacts from the Drip tab. Variables like {{name}} work. If stopOnReply is true, a contact who replies is removed from the sequence.

steps.text: Hi {{name}}! 👋 Thanks for connecting with us. Reply anytime if you need anything 🙂
